blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Thousands flocked to public cemeteries and memorial parks across Caraga starting Oct. 31, as local governments mobilized security forces, medical teams, and maritime enforcers to maintain order during Undas 2026. In Butuan City, families began arriving early on Sunday at Uraya Memorial Gardens in Barangay Bancasi to light candles and offer prayers for their departed loved ones. Anticipating heavier crowds through the weekend, city officials implemented an extensive traffic rerouting scheme around major cemetery corridors to prevent gridlock.
